import numpy as np
eps=df['eps'].values; T=df['T'].values; s=df['sigma'].values
c3=0.62391
base=[eps/(1+c3*eps)*T**3, T*np.log(T)]
sets={
 '1,T,T2':[np.ones_like(T),T,T**2],
 '1,T,T2,T3':[np.ones_like(T),T,T**2,T**3],
 '1,T2':[np.ones_like(T),T**2],
 '1,T,logT':[np.ones_like(T),T,np.log(T)],
 '1,T,TlogT':[np.ones_like(T),T,T*np.log(T)],
 '1,T,T2,logT':[np.ones_like(T),T,T**2,np.log(T)],
 '1,T,T2,TlogT':[np.ones_like(T),T,T**2,T*np.log(T)],
 '1,T3':[np.ones_like(T),T**3],
 '1,T,T3':[np.ones_like(T),T,T**3],
 '1,sqrtT,T':[np.ones_like(T),np.sqrt(T),T],
 '1,1/T,T':[np.ones_like(T),1/T,T],
 '1,T,T2,T3,T4':[np.ones_like(T)]+[T**k for k in range(1,5)],
}
for name,H in sets.items():
    X=np.column_stack([h/eps for h in H]+base)
    coef,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,s,rcond=None)
    print(name, '%.3e'%(np.mean((X@coef-s)**2)/np.var(s)), np.round(coef,4))
